$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 10 adopts AISC 360-05 and gives no geometrically and materially nonlinear analysis with imperfections; the imperfections, material factors and path are SAEngine practice on the AISC 360 basis (out-of-plumbness and out-of-straightness of the direct analysis method); plated parts by EN 1993-1-5 Annex C, cables by EN 1993-1-11 (SAEngine practice); see VERIFY.md
source: SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 gives no method (Part 6 Chapter 10, the AISC 360-05 basis): out-of-plumbness L/500 and out-of-straightness L/1000, EN 1993-1-5 Annex C for plated parts, EN 1993-1-11 for cables

bow.source: AISC 360-05 Appendix 7 Sec 7.3 (out-of-straightness L/1000), the basis of BNBC 2020 Part 6 Ch 10; SAEngine practice

sway.source: AISC 360-05 Appendix 7 Sec 7.3 (out-of-plumbness L/500); SAEngine practice

eigenmode.source: SAEngine practice: the mode scaled to the bow amplitude of the member moving most

plates.source: EN 1993-1-5 Annex C Table C.2 (b/200), SAEngine practice

cables.source: EN 1993-1-11 Sec 6.2 FRd = Fuk / (1.5 γR), γR = 0.90 (SAEngine practice)

sources.yieldFactor: AISC 360 Appendix 1 Sec 1.3 (0.9 Fy in the analysis), SAEngine practice
sources.stiffnessFactor: AISC 360 Appendix 1 Sec 1.3 (0.9 E), SAEngine practice
sources.hardeningRatio: EN 1993-1-5 Annex C Sec C.6 (nominal plateau slope), SAEngine practice

note: BNBC 2020 has no GMNIA rules: these values are SAEngine practice, stated in the results.
